{npc:Norman The Foreman}, foreman of the construction works in the swamp east of Venore, always needs an extra hand. He has three daily tasks — **Maintenance** (oiling machines), **Pathfinder** (delivering supplies) and **Sabotage** (killing corym rats) — that give experience and gold. If you do all three in under 20 hours you also get a bonus: 1000 XP and 1000 gp per day in total.
Norman The Foreman always needs an extra hand to help.
Norman The Foreman, central construction site east of Venore
Bonus (all 3 in under 20 h): 250 XP and 250 gp
Accept all three tasks at once: Maintenance takes you to all three work sites and you can do the other two on the way.
Each task can be repeated 20 hours after you hand it in.
Do the {wiki:Goblin Merchant Quest} at the same time: the tasks *Advertisement*, *Guards* and *Kill* fit easily on this route.

If you are not in **Venore**, take a boat and tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}. Leave **Venore** by the **east** exit (go down at the marked spot). Leave the building and walk a few steps **east** until you find a staircase and/or ramp. Go up and you find {npc:Norman The Foreman} up there.
Say {key:hi} and {key:job}. Then accept each task: {key:maintenance} + {key:yes}, {key:pathfinder} + {key:yes} and {key:sabotage} + {key:yes}.

With the {item:Can of Oil} Norman gave you, you have to oil **3 machines at each of the 3 work sites** (north, centre and south): a {item:Saw (Object)|saw}, a {item:Wooden Treadmill} and a {item:Crane|crane}. You can do them in any order. Use the oil can on each machine.
At the central work site (where Norman is): the {item:Wooden Treadmill} is next to Norman, the {item:Crane} to the **northwest** of him and the {item:Saw (Object)|saw} on the **northeast** platform.
Oil 1 saw (Saw) at each work site
Oil 1 Wooden Treadmill at each work site
Oil 1 crane (Crane) at each work site
Go to the **north** work site. The {item:Wooden Treadmill} and the {item:Saw (Object)|saw} are on the **north** platform; the {item:Crane} is on the **southwest** platform.
Swamp square to dig up the Leech (optional)

While you are here, leave by the north ramp of this work site and hand the {item:Grind Stone} to Scott The Scout (Pathfinder task). If you have not tried in the last 7 days, you can also try digging up a {item:Leech} on a swamp square around here.
Go to the **south** work site. The {item:Wooden Treadmill} and the {item:Saw (Object)|saw} are on the **southwest** platform; the {item:Crane} is on the **south** bridge.
Nearby you can also do the southern part of Pathfinder (Frank The Plank) and Sabotage (hole in the northeast building).
After oiling the 9 machines, go back to {npc:Norman The Foreman} and say {key:maintenance}.
Take the {item:Grind Stone} to {npc:Scott The Scout}, on the bank right after the **north** ramp of the north work site. Say {key:hi} and {key:yes}.
Handing the Grind Stone to Scott The Scout
Take the {item:Pathfinder Kit} to {npc:Frank The Plank}, on the surface next to the **south** work site (see coordinate). Say {key:hi} and {key:yes}.
Handing the Pathfinder Kit to Frank The Plank
Go back to {npc:Norman The Foreman} and say {key:pathfinder}.
Going down the hole at the south work site

At the **south** work site, enter the **northeast** building and go down the hole. Down there you see the *rope spot* the coryms climbed up from the mud: that is where you climb back up with the {item:Rope}. The burrow entrance is right next to it.
Walk **one square south**, to the marked square: you are teleported to a cave below with exactly 5 {creature:Little Corym Charlatan|Little Corym Charlatans}.
Square that teleports you to the cave
Walk 1 square south from here to be teleported to the cave below

Kill the 5 {creature:Little Corym Charlatan|Little Corym Charlatans} and leave the cave: go back the same way to the entrance and use the {item:Rope} on the *rope spot* next to it to climb back up to the northeast building of the south work site. If the coryms are already dead, leave and wait for the respawn — you can go back in as long as you have not killed all 5.
Northeast building of the south work site (where you come back out)
Go back to {npc:Norman The Foreman} and say {key:sabotage}.
If you handed in **all three** tasks in under 20 hours, say {key:bonus} and {key:yes} to {npc:Norman The Foreman}.

The three work sites are in the swamp east of the city. To go back, return to the central work site, go down the stairs/ramp you came up by and enter the building at the **east** exit of Venore; go up at the spot where you came down ({coord:33004,32095,6}).
Each task resets 20 hours after you hand it in: you can repeat them every day.
